_readme: Every writer that files a Linear card automatically (DRE-7452). `disposition` is `notice` — repointed to a console alert by the pipeline-notices epic, with its `notice_key` from that epic's contract — or `kept`: it stays a card, and `reason` opens with why, `work`, `decision` or `record`. `site` names the function or workflow step that files the card when the file also holds other writers. `python3 scripts/notice_writers.py check` discovers every card-creating file in this checkout (and, given `--agent-bureau-dir`, in agent-bureau) and fails on one no row declares for its repo; `report` reads each notice row as repointed, still-files-cards or unread. This repository's CI runs `check` without the flag, so agent-bureau is read only when someone names it.
found: 2026-10-16, an exploration of both repos including a search for raw issueCreate mutations; line numbers drift, files do not
